title: Pork pie - Wiltshire
ingredients: 1 small cooking apple, peeled and chopped
method: Line a greased 9 inch pie plate
Fry onion and bacon in butter
Add pork and cook for 15-20 mins
Leave to cool, then stir in apple, cheese, herbs and seasoning
Add sufficient egg to bind mixture
Fill pie with mixture and add pie lid with steam hole
Bake for 15 mins then reduce to Gas Mark 4 and bake for further 25-30 mins
